message.content:
The most prominent event in 2015 was the **World Chess Championship**.  
In that match, held from November 1‑9, 2015 in Chennai, India, **Magnus Carlsen** successfully defended his title against Sergey Karjakin, winning 6½–3½.  

If you were thinking of another specific tournament (e.g., Tata Steel, Candidates Tournament, etc.), let me know and I can give details on those as well!
